zero_dp_critical_policy.source: English2026 PDF116/11-1 section11.1.2 and PDF118/11-3 Generic Land Targets; source zero-DP gun critical9.6.9
zero_dp_critical_policy.scope: One actual penetrated critical at an unarmored printed Hangar applies its existing aircraft-loss Result without requiring invented direct DP; multiple-critical multiplicity remains specific pending
zero_dp_critical_policy.excluded: No unverified gun penetration, protected HAS, Magazine, runway or custom casualty-result extension

adaptations: Each source Tactical Turn is 180 continuous seconds; spotting counts continuous same-target fire windows, not command clicks.
Scenario authors explicitly configure physical facilities, stored-aircraft assignment, taxiway graph and repair resources; no default base performance is treated as Annex Z data.
Fractional D6/2 and D6/3 aircraft losses retain their die/divisor as pending adjudication when the division is nonintegral, rather than silently guessing a rounding rule.
Runway lengths between source columns and more than ten cuts remain blocked absent author-supplied adjudication; no unsupported interpolation.

Author-declared airfield launch intervals are measured from actual physical release after a runway closure; same-lane jobs cannot collapse into simultaneous launches. Physical lane clocks serialize with the queue.

berth_services_contract.source: English2026 PDF116/11-1 structure function at halfDP or critical; PDF118/11-3 Ship Berth: cannot resupply alongside. The stock-transfer producer below is an explicit scenario/RTS contract, not printed logistics performance.
berth_services_contract.configuration: Each actual unique own depot has one explicitly declared new independent weapon-stock ledger. Services bind exact own depot, source ship_berth facility, actual recipient Ship and aggregate mount/weapon. Capacity, initial stock, distance, allowed speed and seconds per round are explicit author inputs; no equipment fit or rate is inferred.
berth_services_contract.phase: Collect requests during commands, then after movement, the common primary/secondary damage batch, nuclear effects and damage-over-time, cancel invalid/cancelled jobs, commit still-valid due jobs once, and sort new requests by stable recipient/service identity before reserving source stock and recipient capacity. Client interleaving cannot choose a competing reservation winner.
berth_services_contract.conflicts: Exact duplicate starts coalesce. Differing start quantities for one service in one phase reject that service requests; explicit cancellation takes priority over new start in the same phase.
berth_services_contract.accounting: Starting reserves source rounds and recipient free capacity without debit/credit; completion commits exact debit and credit together once. Invalid, dead, missing, foreign, damaged, departed or moving service cancels and releases reservations. No work/time banks across interruption.
berth_services_contract.unsupported: No aggregate replenishment may pretend to reload a torpedo tube, LWT, ASW rocket/projector pattern or explicitly allocated physical component. These fits require their own sourced loading procedures.
berth_services_contract.scope: Explicit experimental alongside transfer and source berth/magazine-loss consumers. Individual physical loading, fuel/AIP and real Annex logistics remain separate.
berth_services_contract.depot_scope: Independent stock ledger remains forbidden on an unspecified Ground target. Explicit kind magazine_bunker must bind the exact Magazine Bunker template. Below structural halfDP, its actual per-critical original D10-turn restriction permits Gun/Ciws ammunition only; at halfDP or rubble no service is possible. Concurrent restrictions retain their latest expiry; timer never rebuilds structure.
berth_services_contract.event_ownership: Private service events retain the original declared Service.owner, even if its recipient or facility subsequently changes side; a new owner never inherits the former side private order through a cancellation receipt.

gci_services_contract.source: English2026 PDF118 Command Bunker no GCI; actual radio transport from6.3 explicit fitted source qualification
gci_services_contract.assignment: Exact unique actual friendly Base controller and Command Bunker, assigned actual Aircraft and existing radio fit. Source or author assumption is explicit. No inferred radio range, warning, Contact or FCS.
gci_services_contract.phase: Collect explicit single-course vectors, settle after committed damage, recheck controller/bunker/radio/aircraft/manual status. Exact duplicates coalesce; conflicting simultaneous vectors do not select a client. Normal navigation applies bridge delay and hardware control.
gci_services_contract.scope: Actual GCI course-order consumer. Does not by itself establish chapter9 surprise eligibility, automatic interception or a standing air mission.

drydock_contract.source: English2026 PDF118 Generic Land Targets: exact pumping station F/84DP/armor3 cannot pump out or flood; exact gate E/245DP/armor9 floods and makes drydock unusable. HalfDP and critical function gate fromPDF116.
drydock_contract.configuration: Unique actual same-side stationary Base controller, exact pump and gate, explicitly declared initial flooded state and positive seconds_per_cycle. The water cycle duration is an author operating assumption, not printed pump performance. No real facility dimensions, ship damage, repair bonus, docking transit or fuel rate are inferred.
drydock_contract.execution: Collect pump requests and resolve after committed damage. Actual pump casualty cancels an unfinished cycle and blocks both drain and flood without fabricating a water-state change. Actual gate casualty immediately floods the dock in that phase, cancels work and persists unusability; no arbitrary timer repairs it.
drydock_contract.determinism: Identical requests coalesce; simultaneous conflicting water-state requests reject. Cycle clock, current water state, original owner and gate cause serialize; missing/foreign/dead/rebound hardware cancels work.
drydock_contract.limits: Water-state operations and source casualty effects are actual consumers. Ship transit and structural drydock repair are separate mechanisms and not supplied by this service.
